Each snippet under ~80 lines with its own {% stylesheet %}.

findings.title: Snippet: quote-form.liquid at 176 lines exceeds ~80 line guardrail
findings.suggested_fix: Split into orchestrator + sub-snippets: step-1 fields, step-2 fields, success/error states. Each under ~80 lines with own {% stylesheet %}.

findings.title: Bug: undeclared variable 'observer' instead of 'this.#observer'
findings.suggested_fix: Change line 94 from 'observer.observe' to 'this.#observer.observe'. This references an undeclared variable and will throw a ReferenceError at runtime.

findings.title: Hardcoded English strings in trust-badges.liquid violate locale-key requirement
findings.suggested_fix: Replace hardcoded defaults ('30+', 'years in the trade', 'store locations', 'Australian owned & operated', 'Call us', '(07) 3356 0000') with locale keys using the | t filter. Phone number should be a block setting, not a hardcoded default.

findings.title: Hardcoded English strings in tds-zone.liquid violate locale-key requirement
findings.suggested_fix: Replace 'Technical Data Sheet (TDS)' and 'Safety Data Sheet (SDS)' with locale keys using the | t filter.

findings.title: Hardcoded English strings in quote-form.liquid violate locale-key requirement
findings.suggested_fix: Replace all hardcoded labels ('Quantity needed', 'Name', 'Email', 'Phone', 'Company', 'Industry', 'Select your industry', industry options, 'Suburb / Location', 'Project notes', placeholder text) with locale keys using the | t filter.

findings.title: Magic numbers in sealant-calculator.liquid CSS violate theme-token requirement
findings.suggested_fix: Replace bare pixel values (16px, 12px, 20px, 28px, 22px, 40px, 44px, 520px, 64px, 10px, 8px, 6px, 11px, 24px, 140px) with theme token var() references. Some var() calls already exist but many values are bare.

findings.title: Magic numbers in quote-form.liquid CSS violate theme-token requirement
findings.suggested_fix: Replace '10px 12px' padding and '32px' background-position with theme token var() references.

findings.title: Magic numbers in vendor-badge.liquid CSS violate theme-token requirement
findings.suggested_fix: Replace 'height: 24px' and 'max-height: 24px' with theme token var() references.

findings.title: Missing {% doc %} blocks in solstice-mega-nav snippets
findings.suggested_fix: Add {% doc %} blocks with @param documentation to all five solstice-mega-nav-*.liquid snippets (top-row, mobile-tree, accordion-drawer, mega-panels, desktop-nav).

findings.title: Missing {% stylesheet %} blocks in solstice-mega-nav snippets
findings.suggested_fix: Add {% stylesheet %} blocks to all five solstice-mega-nav-*.liquid snippets. If styles are shared, consider a single upstream stylesheet — but the standard requires scoped stylesheets per snippet.

findings.title: Hardcoded phone number in trust-badges.liquid
findings.suggested_fix: Move '(07) 3356 0000' to a block setting with a sensible empty default, or use a locale key. Hardcoded phone numbers break reusability.

findings.title: Hardcoded industry dropdown options in quote-form.liquid
findings.suggested_fix: Move industry options to locale keys or a block setting array so they can be translated and customized without editing the snippet.

findings.title: No architecture plan found for new components before implementation
findings.suggested_fix: horizon-build requires an architecture plan at docs/features/[component-name]-architecture.md before coding. Verify plans exist for: buy-mode-toggle, quote-form, sealant-calculator, tds-zone, trust-badges, vendor-badge, solstice-mega-nav. If missing, run horizon-architect retroactively to document the decomposition decisions.

findings.title: Upstream file modification: snippets/scripts.liquid modified without upstream-safety verification
findings.suggested_fix: Check .upstream-baseline.json to confirm scripts.liquid is listed as a custom file. If not, run horizon-upstream-guard before merging. Log the change in docs/customizations/upstream-sync-log.md with rationale and diff anchors.

findings.title: Upstream file modification: templates/product.json heavily modified (+500/-100) without upstream-safety verification
findings.suggested_fix: Check .upstream-baseline.json to confirm product.json is listed as a custom file. If not, run horizon-upstream-guard. The large diff (+500/-100) suggests significant restructuring — document rationale in upstream-sync-log.md.

findings.title: No customization registry entry in docs/customizations/* for new components
findings.suggested_fix: horizon-build requires updating docs/customizations/* ledgers with entries for each new component. Add registry entries for: buy-mode-toggle, quote-form, sealant-calculator, tds-zone, trust-badges, vendor-badge, solstice-mega-nav.

residual_risks.risk: Sealant calculator JS accesses product data via DOM query to product-form-component (line 287-289). If the product form element structure changes upstream, this breaks silently.
residual_risks.mitigation: Add a defensive null check and consider using a custom event for product data sharing instead of DOM scraping.

residual_risks.risk: Quote form uses Shopify's contact form ({% form 'contact' %}) with hardcoded field names. If the store's contact form configuration changes, field mapping may break.
residual_risks.mitigation: Document the expected contact form fields and add a validation comment.

residual_risks.risk: Buy mode toggle uses global querySelector for variant-picker (line 18), which may match the wrong picker on pages with multiple products.
residual_risks.mitigation: Scope the selector to the component's shadow DOM or use a more specific selector tied to the component instance.

residual_risks.risk: Mega nav snippets access section.blocks and section.settings directly, creating tight coupling to section schema. If the section is rendered from a different context, these references break.
residual_risks.mitigation: Pass blocks and settings as explicit render parameters rather than relying on section scope.

residual_risks.risk: The sealant-calculator snippet uses on:click and on:input event handlers (Horizon's custom event syntax). If this syntax is deprecated or behaves differently across Horizon versions, interactivity breaks.
residual_risks.mitigation: Verify on:* syntax is supported in Horizon v3.4.0 and document the dependency.
